selection.rule: First row ID with 100–600 actual PA, all three expected-PA errors below 30 and current rate error below .5 wins/600. Post-fit diagnostic only, no forecast change.

preseason.interpretation: Exact count-weighted node-path decomposition. Correlated features/order affect attribution; not SHAP, causal effects, game-feature ablation, or an independent forecast.
